name: Decision Engine — detect, decide, propose
description: Autonomy primitive: scans Chuck's actual operating state via 6 detectors (failed-task-cluster, zombie-cluster, channel-drift, scanner-tune, orphan-mcp, stale-mac-heal), generates structured proposals (situation + options + recommendation + rationale + risk class + rollback), auto-applies low-risk docket promotions, and stages med/high proposals for Joseph via @openclaw/skill-reach-cascade. Idempotency through fingerprint dedupe (12h window). Anti-flood cap of 3 proposals per scan. Salvages chuck-decision-engine.mjs.

telegramChatId.label: Telegram chat id
telegramChatId.help: Numeric chat id Joseph receives proposal notifications on.

maxProposalsPerScan.label: Anti-flood cap per scan
maxProposalsPerScan.help: Hard cap on proposals emitted per scan run. Surplus hits are skipped + counted in the scan summary.

fingerprintDedupHours.label: Fingerprint dedup window (hours)
fingerprintDedupHours.help: Skip a hit when a proposal with the same pattern-fingerprint was emitted in the last N hours.
